tokens.name: surface-base
tokens.usage: Page ground. The product's default is dark; light is for print and the README.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, the conflict queue, evidence cards.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Graph canvas behind a traversal path.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text. 13.8:1 on surface-base in dark, 14.2:1 in light.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, source paths. 4.9:1 on surface-base.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table borders, graph edges at rest. Never for text.

tokens.name: state-live
tokens.usage: The current claim, the surviving decision, the accent. 6.1:1 on surface-base.

tokens.name: state-contradicted
tokens.usage: A claim in conflict. Pair with the CONTRADICTS glyph — never color alone.

tokens.name: state-superseded
tokens.usage: Retired decisions and the faded strata beneath a live claim. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: state-resolved
tokens.usage: Precedent: a conflict already settled. Distinct from state-live by lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a chip or badge.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, the page gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards in the conflict queue.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section separation.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The default. Panels, tables, the graph canvas. Faultline is square by choice — a records system, not a consumer app.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, evidence spans.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots only.
